notes.title: Go All Out patch 2.16.00
notes.notes:
Go All Out patch 2.16.00 is now live

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36092831/6a65c7055fb08e51220a9da2e9177cf92e05b676.png

Adjustments:
- Move-through disabled by default and available only for defensive actions like dodge and some attacks
- Characters now have insta-turn while moving instead of having to do full turn animation
- Ball Mayhem mode is now disabled in the game
- New free characters rotation

Fixes:
- Fixed problem with too much sliding of characters after certain actions (like item throw)
- Fixed strange color flickering after some cross-stage effects

notes.title: Go All Out patch - Raanan update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36092831/9f1ef4fb35ba694d4a51f1dc837c92ca69cc5415.png

New Content:
- New character: Raanan (Gao Original)
- New Assist Character: Lumina (World to the West)
- New option: Character Outline (Characters can have outline based on team colors for better visibility)
- More sound effects added in Select Screen
- Added an Intro Movie on game start
- Game Mode Update: Online game have default lives set to 2 (from 3)
- Added Flying Hawk (Whispering Willows) to free character rotation


Fixes:
- Fixed problem with visible AI slot in online games
- Fixed problem with crossplay highlights in select screen
- Minor online fixes
- Minor other fixes


Adjustments:
- Upgraded 'move-through' functionality - now characters will stop before enemy while making some combos
- Customizable icons, pillars and emotes are now contained in one section for easier adjustments
- BGM Assigner is moved to customization panel (from Audio Options)
- Adjustem some character portraits in both loading screen and in battle UI

notes.title: Go All Out patch 1.14.00 - Lord Clonington update

notes.title: Go All Out - Lady Scarlet joins the game! Patch 1.10.00
notes.notes:
Go All Out - Lady Scarlet joins the game! 

New Content:
- New character: Lady Scarlet (Desert Child)
- New Support Characters: Baydos Potato / Just Baydos
- New Costume: Vaako Hermit
- New Character Rework: Vaako (Assassin / Thief)
- New game feature: Background Music Selector
- Reworked Shop
- Reworked Game UI
- Reworked Boss UI
- New Reward Popup System for Unlockables
- New Fonts in Game
- New items and emotes in shop
- New Battle Effects and Sounds
- Reworked Camera System
- New Camera Feature - Zoom in on Special Attacks
- Daily Rewards System
- New Lobby Functionality - 'All AI Ready'
- Added new 'Idle Action' animations for most characters
- New and Reworked Combo Moves section in Pause Menu
- World Hub scene updates
- New Controller UI in 'Controls' section
- Summary Screen Rework - new UI and scene background
- Added Wall Bounce Shake
- New Effects on Fall Out
- New Announcer Sounds


Fixes:
- Fixed Calamity error with finishing the fight
- Fixed problem with Yandere's demon wings not appearing
- Fixed problem with Graphite's LVL1 in air not falling properly
- Minor other fixes


Adjustments:
- Added new combo moves for Erica
- Raptor now have initial boost when flying
- Improved AI system
- Reworked Calamity's attacks on both versions
- Reworked knock down type of attack to apply force on every axis
- Reworked Special System priority - Now Lvl1 Special will be vulnerable to Lvl3 Special
- Changes in LVL1 (initial knockback) for Yandere Chan
- Changes in LVL3 (3 empty demons instead of 6 but increased damage) for Yandere Chan
- Movement mechanics have now initial speed and acceleration to full speed

notes.title: Go All Out patch 1.04.00 - 2nd Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
New Content:
- New game feature: Support Characters (5 characters starter pack)
- New game mode: Smash-Out
- New game feature: Icons (first set of 15 icons)
- New Stage: Brick Road
- New items and emotes in shop

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36092831/03e5547aca3ed54d12485c92916bf88ebcfe3f07.jpg

- Fixed desync problem with missile/shot type of projectiles online games
- Fixed Berserk particle on Zorro
- Fixed missing shadow on Yandere-Chans model

- Adjusted Lobby UI for support characters selection.
- Added notification popup when unlocking Support Character

- Adjusted some in-game images
- Adjustem some effects visuals
- Adjusted camera work on some stages
- Adjusted hit boxes on Yandere-Chan, Teslakid, Graphite and Cole Black

notes.title: New character rotation 29.01.2020 + patch
notes.notes:
Hello.

Time for a new rotation of free characters!

This time with some content update - every character got reworked grabs for better gameplay feeling and diversity between characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36092831/f4155bb93091244b915d47d4e6ca408ea4bf1a27.png

In terms of rotation - this time you can check out not 4, but 5 characters: Raptor, Cole Black, Paco & Cool, Yakshi and Yandere-Chan.
